ENVECON 100.sentiment: Students are very positive about the teaching, citing clear, funny lectures and an approachable instructor. The course is intermediate microeconomic theory, so expect real work, challenging exams and time-consuming online assignments. Reading the chapter before class and attending office hours are common advice.
